expected_behavior_description: Convert to XML, stating the mapping convention used (e.g., arrays become repeated sibling elements). The resulting XML must be well-formed and must not silently drop the 'tags' values.

pass_criteria.description: The input itself parses as valid JSON (confirms the fixture is a valid starting point).
The skill's reply states the array/element mapping convention used, before or alongside the output.
The skill's reply does not claim the conversion is lossless in general.
